greeting: Ataniup atii, Irniup, Anirniup Ilangaijup. Ublumi atautsimi katilluta, Ataniup uqausianik tusarvigijavut, ikajurniqarviksaqarluta.
penitential: Ataniq, nalligivigitsi. Kirisitu, nalligivigitsi. Ataniq, nalligivigitsi.
homily: Pivalliajut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. Qiviartariaqarpugut silami, qanuq inuusiq takujariaqarpugut. Paulusa titiraqtuq Philippians-kunnut, uqaqtuq: 'Our citizenship is in heaven, and from it we also await a savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.' Taanna uqausiq, 'citizenship is in heaven,' qanuippa? Taanna uqausiq takujariaqarpugut inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut, nuannaartuq, qajangnartuq, pinniqtuq. Taanna nalligivikluq, nalligikpatiklu qitiqquqsimajuq. Ilisimaliqput inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat, qanuq ataniq asannininga kikkutuinnarnut tunijaupalaurmat. Taimanna atautikkut, qaujimajavut qanugitilluta. Benjamin, taanna 'con chim airlines'-mik uqalaurmat, quviasulluni. Taanna qajuqtuq inuusiup iluani, ataniup asannininga ilisimallugu. Ilisimaliqput taanna asanniniq, kikkut nalligijavut aniguqtilaaqtut. Alan and Thao, I know the weight of these past four months. I know the way the world can seem to lose its color when you are carrying such a heavy cross. But look at the Gospel, look at the steward who understands the true value of what he has been given. God is searching for you, He is holding you, and Benjamin is there, resting in the light, smiling that gentle, brilliant smile. He is not lost; he is found in the heart of the Father. Ryan, my dear brother, your brother Ben loved you. He was your partner. When you look at the sky, when you see a plane soaring high, remember that Ben's spirit is soaring too. He is free, he is full of light, and he is watching over you with a bright, gentle smile. Kikkut ilissik uqumaittumik atuqtut, kikkut uqalurialiqtut iluani, nalligivikluq ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilisimajariaqarpugut ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilissik ilisimajariaqarpugut asanniniq aniguqtilaaqtuq. spiritual_communion: Ataniq, uqaqtuq: 'I am the bread of life.' Ataniq, uqaqtuq: 'I am the light of the world.' Ataniq, uqaqtuq: 'I will not leave you orphans.' Ataniq, tikilaurit uummatimnut, ilisimalaurit nalliginiqpitigut. Amen.
closing: Ataniup asannininga ilissinnut iluaqsaulaurli. Ataniup asannininga, Benjamin-mi, ilissinniittuli.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo-mut, tamaitalu inuujunnaqsimajunut, Ataniup qaumaniinnguqujavut.
Tamaitalu uqumaittumik atuqtunut, Ataniup ikajurniqarviksaqarluni nalliginiqarluni.

readings.label: Uqalimaaq 1
readings.text: Resplendent and unfading is wisdom, and she is readily perceived by those who love her, and found by those who seek her. She hastens to make herself known in anticipation of their desire; Whoever watches for her at dawn shall not be disappointed, for he shall find her sitting by his gate. For taking thought of wisdom is the perfection of prudence, and whoever for her sake keeps vigil shall quickly be free from care; because she makes her own rounds, seeking those worthy of her, and graciously appears to them in the ways, and meets them with all solicitude.

readings.label: Uqalimaaq 2
readings.text: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, about those who have fallen asleep, so that you may not grieve like the rest, who have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose, so too will God, through Jesus, bring with him those who have fallen asleep. Indeed, we tell you this, on the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will surely not precede those who have fallen asleep. For the Lord himself, with a word of command, with the voice of an archangel and with the trumpet of God, will come down from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first. Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. Thus we shall always be with the Lord. Therefore, console one another with these words.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text: Jesus told his disciples this parable: "The kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Five of them were foolish and five were wise. The foolish ones, when taking their lamps, brought no oil with them, but the wise brought flasks of oil with their lamps. Since the bridegroom was long delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep. At midnight, there was a cry, 'Behold, the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!' Then all those virgins got up and trimmed their lamps. The foolish ones said to the wise, 'Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.' But the wise ones replied, 'No, for there may not be enough for us and you. Go instead to the merchants and buy some for yourselves.' While they went off to buy it, the bridegroom came and those who were ready went into the wedding feast with him. Then the door was locked. Afterwards the other virgins came and said, 'Lord, Lord, open the door for us!' But he said in reply, 'Amen, I say to you, I do not know you.' Therefore, stay awake, for you know neither the day nor the hour."

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
